answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of unique orchard manager record with horticultural association attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the timber of the check, count the prism of the cost, and read the juniper of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
